lastResponse.text: Absolutely. Two options you can use right now, and you can share only what you want. In Gresham, call City of Gresham: 503… 618… 3000 and ask for a veteran housing referral. If you can travel or want a veteran-specific program, try Veterans Housing Project in Eugene: 458… 221… 0718. If it helps, keep it simple: “I’m a veteran in Gresham and need housing help today.” You don’t need to give extra details until you’re ready.
